title: QuantifyPolyA: User Manual
text: Remove poly() sites potentially result internal priming events. Arguments: QpolyA: QuantifyPolyA object containing raw poly() sites. fasta: string specifying location name corresponding genome file FASTA format. flank_len: neighborhood (bp) searched side poly() site template poly() stretch. Default 15. win_size: size sliding window, bp. Default 10. min_A: minimum number consecutive adenines window site flagged internal priming. Default 8. site called internal priming artifact genomic sequence around contains run least min_A adenines (thymines minus strand) within win_size-bp window inside coord +/- flank_len. Changed 0.4.0. three arguments previously exist values hard-coded (flank_len = 10, win_size = 10, min_A = 7). defaults now 15, 10 8, results identical version 0.3.0. reproduce old behaviour:
code: QpolyA <- Remove.IP(QpolyA, fasta = "Genome.fasta") QpolyA <- Remove.IP(QpolyA, fasta = "Genome.fasta",  flank_len = 10, win_size = 10, min_A = 7)

title: QuantifyPolyA: User Manual
text: Cluster poly() sites poly() site clusters (PACs) using weighted density peak clustering algorithm. Arguments: QpolyA: QuantifyPolyA object containing clean poly() sites. max.gapwidth: cutoff limiting maximum distance two adjacent poly() sites PAC. Default 24. mc.cores: number processors/cores used clustering. Default 4.

title: QuantifyPolyA: User Manual
text: Visualize poly() profiles specific gene across multiple samples. Arguments: QpolyA: QuantifyPolyA object containing clean poly() sites PAC table. anno: GRanges object gene model information, generated example rtracklayer::import(). gene.id: string indicating gene visualized, e.g. gene.id = "ENSMUSG00000073490". sample.names: character vector specifying samples display. samples shown omitted. coord.lim: two numeric values specifying left right limits x-axis. returned object ggplot2 object can customized standard ggplot2 functions.
code: library(rtracklayer) anno <- import("Genome.annotation.gtf")  gene_id <- "XXXXXXXX" dp <- Visualize.PolyA(QpolyA, anno, gene_id)  library(ggsci) dp + scale_color_aaas() + scale_fill_aaas()

title: QuantifyPolyA: User Manual
text: Prepare data: Download Arabidopsis_FY.zip SourceForge project page, TAIR10 genome TAIR10_chr_all.fas TAIR, annotation Arabidopsis_thaliana.TAIR10.45.gtf.gz EnsemblPlants. Move three files working directory unzip . Illustration gene CIPK9 showing dynamic APA profiles wild type (wt) double mutant (fy3oxt6) samples. PCA plot based PAC matrix (Arabidopsis dataset).
code: library(QuantifyPolyA)  #1. Load raw poly(A) site data. QpolyA <- Load.PolyA(dir = "./Arabidopsis_FY")  #2. Remove internal priming artifacts. QpolyA <- Remove.IP(QpolyA, "TAIR10_chr_all.fas")  #3. Cluster poly(A) sites. QpolyA <- Cluster.PolyA(QpolyA, max.gapwidth = 24, mc.cores = 16)  #4. Annotate and quantify poly(A) site clusters. QpolyA <- Annotate.PolyA(  QpolyA, "Arabidopsis_thaliana.TAIR10.45.gtf",  seq.levels = as.character(unique(QpolyA@polyA$seqnames)) )  #5. Filter out PACs with low read count support. QpolyA <- Filter.PolyA(QpolyA, min_count = 10, min_sample = 1)  #6. Quantify APA dynamics. colData <- data.frame(  condition = c(rep("fy3",3), rep("fy3oxt6",3),  rep("oxt6",3), rep("wt",3)),  type = "single-end" ) rownames(colData) <- QpolyA@sample_names  split.APA <- Quantify.SplitAPA(QpolyA, colData, contrast = c("condition", "wt", "oxt6")) canonical.APA <- Quantify.CanonicalAPA(QpolyA, colData, contrast = c("condition", "wt", "oxt6")) cnc.APA <- Quantify.CNCAPA(QpolyA, colData, contrast = c("condition", "wt", "oxt6")) gene.APA <- Quantify.GeneAPA(QpolyA, colData, contrast = c("condition", "wt", "oxt6"))  #7. Visualize poly(A) profiles. library(rtracklayer) anno <- import("Arabidopsis_thaliana.TAIR10.45.gtf")  gene_id <- "AT1G01140" dp <- Visualize.PolyA(QpolyA, anno, gene_id, sample.names = c("wt", "fy3oxt6"))  library(ggsci) dp + scale_color_aaas() + scale_fill_aaas()  #8. Perform DESeq2 analysis. res <- DESeq2.PolyA(QpolyA, colData)  library(DESeq2) compare_wt_oxt6 <- results(res$DESeq2.Result,  contrast = c("condition", "wt", "oxt6")) compare_wt_oxt6.df <- as.data.frame(compare_wt_oxt6)  summary(compare_wt_oxt6) sum(compare_wt_oxt6$padj < 0.05, na.rm = TRUE)  res$PCA.Plot

title: QuantifyPolyA: User Manual
text: Prepare data: Download Human_MAQC.zip SourceForge project page, genome Homo_sapiens.GRCh38.dna.primary_assembly.fa.gz annotation Homo_sapiens.GRCh38.101.gtf.gz Ensembl. Move three files working directory unzip . Illustration gene PCNX1 showing dynamic APA profiles brain UHR samples. PCA plot based PAC matrix (human dataset).
code: library(QuantifyPolyA)  #1. Load raw poly(A) site data. QpolyA <- Load.PolyA(dir = "./Human_MAQC")  #2. Remove internal priming artifacts. QpolyA <- Remove.IP(QpolyA, "Homo_sapiens.GRCh38.dna.primary_assembly.fa")  #3. Cluster poly(A) sites. QpolyA <- Cluster.PolyA(QpolyA, max.gapwidth = 24, mc.cores = 16)  #4. Annotate and quantify poly(A) site clusters. QpolyA <- Annotate.PolyA(QpolyA, "Homo_sapiens.GRCh38.101.gtf")  #5. Filter out PACs with low read count support. QpolyA <- Filter.PolyA(QpolyA, min_count = 10, min_sample = 1)  #6. Quantify APA dynamics. colData <- data.frame(  condition = c(rep("Brain",2), rep("UHR",2)),  type = "single-end" ) rownames(colData) <- QpolyA@sample_names  split.APA <- Quantify.SplitAPA(QpolyA, colData, contrast = c("condition", "Brain", "UHR")) canonical.APA <- Quantify.CanonicalAPA(QpolyA, colData, contrast = c("condition", "Brain", "UHR")) cnc.APA <- Quantify.CNCAPA(QpolyA, colData, contrast = c("condition", "Brain", "UHR")) gene.APA <- Quantify.GeneAPA(QpolyA, colData, contrast = c("condition", "Brain", "UHR"))  #7. Visualize poly(A) profiles. library(rtracklayer) anno <- import("Homo_sapiens.GRCh38.101.gtf")  gene_id <- "ENSG00000164091" dp <- Visualize.PolyA(QpolyA, anno, gene_id, coord.lim = c(52254310,52255210))  library(ggsci) dp + scale_color_aaas() + scale_fill_aaas()  #8. Perform DESeq2 analysis. res <- DESeq2.PolyA(QpolyA, colData)  library(DESeq2) compare_Brain_UHR <- results(res$DESeq2.Result,  contrast = c("condition", "Brain", "UHR")) compare_Brain_UHR.df <- as.data.frame(compare_Brain_UHR)  summary(compare_Brain_UHR) sum(compare_Brain_UHR$padj < 0.05, na.rm = TRUE)  res$PCA.Plot

title: QuantifyPolyA 0.4.0
text: Remove.IP() .internal.priming() gain three arguments controlling internal priming detection: flank_len (default 15), win_size (default 10) min_A (default 8). detection window now coord +/- flank_len threshold min_A adenines sliding window win_size bases, replacing previously hard-coded coord +/- 10 / >=7 / window 10. defaults changed, results Remove.IP() identical version 0.3.0. reproduce old behaviour use Remove.IP(QpolyA, fasta, flank_len = 10, win_size = 10, min_A = 7).
